## Problem Statement / Motivation
(What problem does this feature solve? Please describe the use case or the pain point you are experiencing.)

## Technical Considerations (Optional)
(Describe potential technical impacts. For example: 

 - Performance: Will this increase frame time (ms) or CPU/GPU overhead?
 - VRAM/Memory: Does it require significant memory allocation?
 - Compatibility: Does it require specific Vulkan extensions or hardware features?
 - Side Effects: Will it affect existing rendering pipelines or shader logic?

We encourage using AI tools to brainstorm these architectural impacts.)

## Alternatives Considered (Optional)
(A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.
